user.description: Pick the printer added by the Bambu Lab (ha-bambulab) integration.

data.ai_task_entity: AI to read the label (unknown barcode)

data_description.ai_task_entity: Optional: an AI task entity that accepts images. When a barcode is unknown, the panel offers to photograph the label and the AI suggests the filament.

edit_item.title: Rename filament
edit_item.description: Filaments come from the Bambu profiles (AMS slots, your own profiles in Bambu Studio). Here you only override the name shown in Home Assistant. Leave empty to use the name from Bambu.
